Subject: Pilot voucher request & SOW — Bluewave SI pilot

Hi Sofia,

Quick intro — I'm Aisha, partnerships lead at Bluewave Labs. We're kicking off a proof-of-concept later this month with one of our SI partners (Northstar Integrations) to validate a Redwood-backed LLM workflow for their logistics product.

High level:
- Pilot length: 6 weeks (Dec 1 start)
- Expected volume: ~150k tokens/week initially, spiking to ~400k during a burst test
- Objectives: latency & cost profile benchmark, small production pilot for 2 customers

Bluewave ideally covers some of the initial infra risk via a partner-sourced voucher so the SI can run without committing their own budget. Attached is the pilot SOW and a completed voucher request form. Can Redwood adjudicate a marketplace/partner credit for this cohort?

Asks:
- Eligibility & typical allocation size for SI-led pilots
- Any usage caps or canary rules you require
- Timeline for approval and DocuSign if needed

Appreciate a quick read — we’re trying to finalize onboarding with Northstar by 11/24.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Partnerships, Bluewave Labs

- Approve start date 12/1 pending signed voucher terms and SOW.

1) Signed voucher terms (see voucher_terms_2026.docx) — legal must sign off; DocuSign link to follow.
2) Canary cap: cap the first week at 60k tokens; if telemetry looks good we can lift to requested levels.
3) Billing code & HubSpot deal link provided by Bluewave for bookkeeping.

Vanessa — please confirm whether we pull from the ecosystem accelerator budget or merchant partner pool. If we use accelerator budget, route to finance code ACC-2026-PROMO. If partner pool, use PRTN-COOP-19.
